name: Anime & Manga

items.title: Sakura Dreams
items.accessibilityLabel: Sakura petals gently flutter in the breeze under sunlight... a true display of nature's beauty and elegance.

name: Cyberpunk & Tech
summary: Neon glitches, high-tech visors, and neural interfaces.

products.summary: Witness the entire world in motion.

items.title: Cyberspace
items.description: Witness the entire world in motion.
items.accessibilityLabel: Cyberspace. Witness the entire world in motion.

name: Fantasy & Magic
summary: Mystical runes, dragon crowns, and enchanted spells.

products.summary: Legends say this could power an entire server...

items.title: Boost Relic
items.description: Legends say this could power an entire server...
items.accessibilityLabel: Boost Relic. Legends say this could power an entire server...

items.title: Magic Hearts
items.accessibilityLabel: Hearts are beating and shimmering upon the profile, binding you under its charm.

products.name: Mystic Vines
products.summary: Why touch grass when you can touch magical vines?

items.title: Mystic Vines
items.description: Why touch grass when you can touch magical vines?
items.accessibilityLabel: Magical vines grow and wrap around the outer edges of the profile. Is Mother Nature feeling extra affectionate today?

products.name: Dragon Dance
products.summary: No evil spirits on my watch.

items.title: Dragon Dance
items.description: No evil spirits on my watch.
items.accessibilityLabel: A dragon glides into view on top of the profile, circling a few times before taking rest at the very top.

name: Cute & Cozy
summary: Adorable companions, froggy hats, and pastel dreams.

products.name: Heartzilla
products.summary: Is this what they mean when they say love hurts?

items.title: Heartzilla
items.description: Is this what they mean when they say love hurts?
items.accessibilityLabel: A clawed paw slashes and tears through the profile. Out floods... red hearts! How cute!

products.name: Clove's Ruse
products.summary: Smoke's out. Time to make some mischief.

items.title: Clove's Ruse
items.description: Smoke's out. Time to make some mischief.
items.accessibilityLabel: Clove summons a sphere of smoke over the profile.

products.name: The Immortal Clove
products.summary: They've got all the time in the world.

items.title: The Immortal Clove
items.description: They've got all the time in the world.
items.accessibilityLabel: Clove poses on the profile with fabulous style.

name: Dark & Gothic
summary: Shadow realm reapers, cursed flames, and gothic spines.

items.title: Dark Omens
items.accessibilityLabel: A ghastly portal suddenly appears, summoning three ghostly spirits to haunt your enemies - no one gets to beat you in a game and get away with it.

name: Retro Arcade & Gaming
summary: 8-bit nostalgia, pixel hearts, and synthwave beats.

name: Elements & Nature
summary: Raw elemental powers: fire, ice, storm, earth, and ocean.

products.name: Watercolors
products.summary: When the world feels grey, add a splash of color.

items.title: Watercolors
items.description: When the world feels grey, add a splash of color.
items.accessibilityLabel: Soft, colorful circles illuminate the profile amid gentle raindrops.

items.title: NiCe pRoFiLE
items.accessibilityLabel: SpongeBob waddles onto the profile with his arms nested onto his hips like a chicken. He kicks off the ground a few times before rapidly flapping his arms and somehow flying away. Who showed him the plaid this time?

name: Celestial & Stars
summary: Cosmic galaxies, starry constellations, and celestial bodies.

items.title: Shooting Stars
items.accessibilityLabel: Several shooting stars streak across the profile - don't forget to make a wish!

products.name: Space Evader
products.summary: That was the best flying I've seen to date - right up to the part where you got hit.

items.title: Space Evader
items.description: That was the best flying I've seen to date - right up to the part where you got hit.
items.accessibilityLabel: A spaceship quickly barrelrolls out of the way from a barrage of laser fire. Unfortunately, it doesn't evade the follow up missile attack and gets taken out. Better luck next time.

name: Celebrations & Vault
summary: Festive treasures, fireworks, envelopes, and exclusive collectibles.

products.name: A sphere of gusting wind swirls around the avatar.
products.summary: A sphere of gusting wind swirls around the avatar.

items.label: A sphere of gusting wind swirls around the avatar.

items.title: Hydro Blast
items.accessibilityLabel: A powerful stream of water swirls and twirls in the air. Wait, where's it headed off to?!

items.title: Shatter
items.accessibilityLabel: Rippling flames travel across a layer of glass, shattering it. How bittersweet that the glass, molded by fire's embrace, be undone by the very flames that forged it.

products.name: Power Surge
products.summary: You're about to witness true power.

items.title: Power Surge
items.description: You're about to witness true power.
items.accessibilityLabel: A surge of power erupts, surrounding the profile with an aura of intense energy. Those who gaze upon it will be left in awe.

products.name: Shuriken Strike
products.summary: Every side is the pointy end.

items.title: Shuriken Strike
items.description: Every side is the pointy end.
items.accessibilityLabel: Three shurikens are thrown, spinning furiously until they finally strike their target. Ow, those must've hurt.

items.title: Pixie Dust
items.accessibilityLabel: Glimmering pixie dust and sparkles adorn the outer edges of the profile, casting a radiant glow.

products.name: Discord-Os
products.summary: Bet you can't have just one bowl.

items.title: Discord-Os
items.description: Bet you can't have just one bowl.
items.accessibilityLabel: Cereal and milk pour in from the heavens, flooding the profile in delicious, nutritious goodness. You can't beat the classics.

products.name: Breakfast Plate
products.summary: The best meal for any time of day.

items.title: Breakfast Plate
items.description: The best meal for any time of day.
items.accessibilityLabel: Eggs, bacon, berries, and toast unite to form a breakfast meal, arranged with a smile. You can hear the bellies of profile admirers everywhere rumbling.

items.title: Ghoulish Graffiti
items.accessibilityLabel: Graffiti-esque stars are strobing across the profile. But wait, you notice there's something written in the stars... 'BOO!' Did we get ya?

products.name: Zombie Slime
products.summary: I don't think you should touch that.

items.title: Zombie Slime
items.description: I don't think you should touch that.
items.accessibilityLabel: Out of nowhere, a glob of slime suddently drops from above, forming into a skull before vaporizing in the air. Did someone just curse you?

items.title: Fall Foliage
items.accessibilityLabel: A cascade of autumn leaves gently sway and fall from their trees towards the earth. Shall we make the biggest leaf pile the world has ever seen?

items.title: Lillypad Life
items.accessibilityLabel: Under drizzling rain, a frog hops onto a floating lilypad, then hops away... perhaps never to be seen again. Farewell, frog friend.

products.name: Deck the halls
products.summary: Keep out of reach from cats

items.title: Deck the halls
items.description: Keep out of reach from cats
items.accessibilityLabel: Festive string lights wrap around the user profile

items.title: Snowy Shenanigans
items.accessibilityLabel: In a sudden gust of snow and wind, a snowman sweeps into and out of view, leaving behind a flurry of snow in his wake. Who knows if we'll ever see him again...

products.name: Goozilla
products.summary: Wait a second, what's my profile even made of?!

items.title: Goozilla
items.description: Wait a second, what's my profile even made of?!
items.accessibilityLabel: A clawed paw slashes and tears through the profile. Out oozes... slimy green goo? Gross!

items.title: Monster Pop
items.accessibilityLabel: A purple, cheeky little creature floats across the screen. It's so adorable~~ wo-woah woahhh it just exploded!

items.title: Nightrunner
items.accessibilityLabel: A slick-looking car cruises through a futuristic city, dodging obstacles and speeding off in a neon glow of superspeed light.

items.title: Uplink Error
items.accessibilityLabel: Uh oh, looks like the data of this profile is fractured. Glitches flicker across screen in a series of surprisingly aesthetically pleasing colors.

items.title: Fortune Flurry
items.accessibilityLabel: A slew of red envelopes ride the wind and rush through the profile.

items.title: Midnight Celebration
items.accessibilityLabel: Fireworks ignite and light up the profile surrounded by ornamental designs.

products.name: Rock Slide
products.summary: A ballet of rock and stone.

items.title: Rock Slide
items.description: A ballet of rock and stone.
items.accessibilityLabel: A cascade of large rocks swirl into view, then settle around the frame of the profile. Talk about heavy lifting.

products.name: Vortex
products.summary: Beware the eye of the storm.

items.title: Vortex
items.description: Beware the eye of the storm.
items.accessibilityLabel: A giant whirlwind forms across the profile. Wouldn't want to get caught in the middle of that!

items.title: Mastery
items.accessibilityLabel: A mix of fire, water, earth, and wind swirl into the profile's view, then neatly settle around the profile's frame in perfect harmony.

items.title: Dreamy
items.accessibilityLabel: A radiant, dreamy aura of vibrant colors and glowing sparkles cover the profile, conveying the state of being in a happy dream.

items.title: Ki Detonate
items.accessibilityLabel: A ball of raw, powerful energy is about to detonate in the center of the profile and obliterate everything in its radius. We should probably be hiding behind something right now.

items.title: Sushi Mania
items.accessibilityLabel: A variety of sushi suddenly appears on the profile. Sushi lovers are ecstatic about this sudden occurrence.

items.title: Petal Serenade
items.accessibilityLabel: The profile comes alive with a burst of spring flowers that serenade the profile with colorful petals.

products.name: Fellowship of the Spring
products.summary: They only gather around this time of the year.

items.title: Fellowship of the Spring
items.description: They only gather around this time of the year.
items.accessibilityLabel: A gathering of spring bugs and insects bustle around the profile. One cannot help but think they seem to be pursuing an important mission to a faraway land...

items.title: Spring Bloom
items.accessibilityLabel: Cheerful thunderclouds release a gentle rain that awakens the dormant flowers around them into full bloom.

items.title: ACE
items.accessibilityLabel: A kill banner displaying 5 confirmed kills.

items.title: Study Spot
items.accessibilityLabel: A jumble of stationery and electronics appear on the profile, indicating a serious study session about to take place.

items.title: All Nighter
items.accessibilityLabel: A soft glare of morning light bathes a profile adorned with houseplants and stringlights.

items.title: Supernova
items.accessibilityLabel: A supernova explodes, leaving behind a glittering aftermath of stars.

products.name: Twilight
products.summary: Is the universe winking at me?

items.title: Twilight
items.description: Is the universe winking at me?
items.accessibilityLabel: Twilight gently covers the profile, revealing twinkling stars.

items.title: Feelin' Mischievous
items.accessibilityLabel: A digital, goofy face zips onto the profile, blows a raspberry, and leaves behind a poop.

products.name: Feelin' 90s
products.summary: Your uncle has a shirt just like this.

items.title: Feelin' 90s
items.description: Your uncle has a shirt just like this.
items.accessibilityLabel: Colorful shapes and patterns decorate the profile with good ol' fashioned 90's pizzazz.

items.title: Feelin' Pizzazz
items.accessibilityLabel: Colorful zigzags playfully decorate the profile's frame and centerspace.

products.name: Jolly Roger
products.summary: Ye be warned... give no quarter.

items.title: Jolly Roger
items.description: Ye be warned... give no quarter.
items.accessibilityLabel: A black pirate flag depicting the famed Jolly Roger skull and crossbones gets slashed by a cutlass. Surely this means war!

products.name: Forgotten Treasure
products.summary: Many a greedy eye be yearnin' for a peek... guard yer secrets closely.

items.title: Forgotten Treasure
items.description: Many a greedy eye be yearnin' for a peek... guard yer secrets closely.
items.accessibilityLabel: A treasure map detailing the location of buried treasure, with a curious skull marked along the path.

products.name: Haunted Man O' War
products.summary: Sail Ho! We be in cursed waters now...

items.title: Haunted Man O' War
items.description: Sail Ho! We be in cursed waters now...
items.accessibilityLabel: A haunted Man O' War pirate ship eerily drifts across the profile, a sight that sends shivers down the spines of even the hardest of sailors.

products.name: Turbo Drive
products.summary: Give your rivals a cheeky wave from the rearview.

items.title: Turbo Drive
items.description: Give your rivals a cheeky wave from the rearview.
items.accessibilityLabel: In its final lap, a racing car skillfully serves around the final corner before accelerating across the finish line to secure first place.

products.name: Twinkle Trails
products.summary: Chase the stars to collect them all.

items.title: Twinkle Trails
items.description: Chase the stars to collect them all.
items.accessibilityLabel: Magical stars float into open view before traveling into surrounding pipes. Collect all the stars while they're out in the open!

products.name: Saya
products.summary: A mysterious beauty blossoms under the moonlight.

items.title: Saya
items.description: A mysterious beauty blossoms under the moonlight.
items.accessibilityLabel: Saya appears over the profile, the glowing beauty of the crescent moon behind her. Wait... why do I hear boss music?

products.name: Wake Up!
products.summary: You wash ashore on a strange island...

items.title: Wake Up!
items.description: You wash ashore on a strange island...
items.accessibilityLabel: Lamball, Cattiva, and Chikipi curiously poke their heads out to stare at the mysterious new face who just washed up on their island.

items.title: Tocotoco
items.accessibilityLabel: A Tocotoco suddenly emerges out of nowhere and waddles towards you before dramatically exploding. There goes your base, half your Pals, and hours of progress!

items.title: Arcane Summons
items.accessibilityLabel: A circular sigil inscribed with mysterious symbols appears, summoned by someone preparing to unleash its arcane power. Hope you got some magic resistance.

items.title: Vengeance
items.accessibilityLabel: A cursed skull engulfed in flames appears, staring at you with its mouth agape as if letting out an angry scream. Did someone just hex you?

items.title: Spirit Flame
items.accessibilityLabel: A ribbon of luminous, ethereal flame flares across the profile, illuminating it with a hauntingly beautiful glow.

items.title: Handsome Squidward
items.accessibilityLabel: Squidward's handsome, chiseled face appears, and gives a charming wink. Handsome Squidward then proceeds to glide across the profile with an elegant, ballet-like twirl.

items.title: DoodleBob Takeover
items.accessibilityLabel: DoodleBob walks onto the profile holding a giant pencil. He lets out a roar of defiance and starts to maniacally erase the surface of the profile itself, revealing... flower clouds?! Have we been living in Bikini Bottom this entire time?

products.name: Plankton Splat
products.summary: Stealing the Krabby Patty secret formula.

items.title: Plankton Splat
items.description: Stealing the Krabby Patty secret formula.
items.accessibilityLabel: Plankton angrily walks onto the middle of the profile when suddenly SpongeBob walks by and unknowingly squishes Plankton into a puddle with his shoe.

items.title: Ocean Flowers
items.accessibilityLabel: Several brightly colored ocean flowers pop up across the profile, now submerged with an underwater ambiance. Welcome to Bikini Bottom!
